25.1.14
进行了2.0.1更新：
1.修复了万灵节站位和节日期间出现的smapi黄字，第二年节日无法出现等问题
2.增加了sve的兼容性和i18n（感谢[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/HydrangeaGardenTea/about-me]HydrangeaGardenTea[/url]！）

[/size]
[b][size=3]关于肖像[/size]
[/b]
确保已经安装了 [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]。
如果你是第一次使用Portraiture，
在Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/下，新建一个999文件夹，
把【Portrait】文件夹内的图片，放进999文件夹，
打开游戏，在对话的时候按【p】

如果你使用过Portraiture，
直接把【Portrait】文件夹内的图片，与其他的高清肖像放在同一个文件夹。

[b][size=3]其他问题[/size][/b]

这个mod我自己测试是没有问题的，但不排除会不会跟一些别的mod冲突导致一些bug，例如在节日期间无法对话等。可以通过[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's move it[/url] 解决。
在八心事件时，smapi会出现大量黄字，不会影响剧情发展，也不会影响游戏。
目前我没有解决方法，如果有人可以解决的话，可以留言或者通过小红书[url=https://www.xiaohongshu.com/user/profile/5f05b793000000000101f624]@桃桃优酪乳[/url]联系我。

目前没有英文版，如果有人愿意做的话请随意。

[size=3]25.1.14
Updated to 2.0.1:
1. Fixed the Smapi yellow text issues and positioning during the festival, as well as issues where the second year festival could not occur.
2. Increased sve compatibility and i18n (thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/HydrangeaGardenTea/about-me]HydrangeaGardenTea[/url]!)
If you play Sve, you don't need to download the optional files below[/size]

[b][size=3]About portraits[/size][/b]

Make sure [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] is installed.
If this is your first time using Portraiture,
Create a new 999 folder under Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/,
Put the pictures in the [Portrait] folder into the 999 folder.
Open the game and press [p] during the conversation.

If you have used Portraiture,
Directly put the pictures in the [Portrait] folder into the same folder as other high-definition portraits.

[b][size=3]Other questions[/size][/b]

There is currently no English version, if anyone wants to do this please feel free.

During the 8 Hearts event, a large number of yellow codes will appear in smapi, which will not affect the plot or game development. I don't have a solution at the moment. If anyone can solve it, please leave a message
I tested this mod myself and there were no problems, but I don't rule out that it might conflict with some other mods, causing some bugs, such as being unable to talk during festivals. This can be solved by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's move it[/url].
